---
name: Obtain TA grading-policy approval
about: Formal Phase 1 sign-off; required by Phase 3 scientific validation
labels: ai, research, p1
---
- [ ] Review `questions.json` question bank and key version
- [ ] Confirm accepted short answers and wrong-answer contrasts per course
- [ ] Confirm MCQ multiple-mark policy
- [ ] Confirm math precision / units / symbolic domain / partial credit
- [ ] Confirm essay rubric and criterion weights / scaling
- [ ] Confirm human review thresholds and when manual override is mandatory
- [ ] Record dated TA / supervisor approval with immutable version (not a simulated signoff)
